dev.changes_summary: Two targeted insertions in scripts/lib/react_template.tpl: (1) Fix Site 1 — added `dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].skipped = false;` after the options-array guard in handleSidebarDrop's setEditorTripData updater (line 2366), unconditionally clearing the skipped flag whenever the deselect path touches the slot. (2) Fix Site 2 — added an independent setEditorTripData block in applyBridge after setEditorSelections(), scoped to MEAL_SLOTS, that clears dayEntry.slots[targetSlotId].skipped = false regardless of originSlotId value (line 2956–2966).

tasks_completed.description: Fix Site 1: Clear skipped flag in handleSidebarDrop setEditorTripData updater
tasks_completed.changes: Inserted `dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].skipped = false;` at line 2366, immediately after `if (!dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].options) dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].options = [];`. Placed unconditionally before the `already` check so it fires whether or not option synthesis runs.
tasks_completed.rationale: R1: Day 1 breakfast/lunch are seeded with skipped:true by the server. handleSidebarDrop's updater never wrote skipped=false, leaving isGated permanently true and data-droppable permanently false after board-to-sidebar drag.

tasks_completed.description: Fix Site 2: Add unconditional setEditorTripData block in applyBridge to clear skipped on MEAL_SLOTS targets
tasks_completed.changes: Inserted an independent setEditorTripData block guarded by `MEAL_SLOTS && MEAL_SLOTS.has(targetSlotId) && setEditorTripData` immediately after setEditorSelections() and before the existing `if (originSlotId && originSlotId !== targetSlotId && ...)` block. The new block clears dayEntry.slots[targetSlotId].skipped = false unconditionally, covering the sidebar-to-board path where originSlotId is null.
tasks_completed.rationale: R2: applyBridge's prior setEditorTripData block was guarded by `originSlotId && originSlotId !== targetSlotId`, skipping it entirely when originSlotId=null (sidebar drop). The new block fires independently of that guard, ensuring skipped is cleared even when dropping from sidebar with no origin slot.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — not a regression; pre-arrival skipped flag was always present but the deselect+re-add flow was not previously supported
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The skipped flag was added to handle pre-arrival placeholder display. No clearing code was added because the add-back flow was not originally in scope.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Both write paths (deselect via handleSidebarDrop, re-select via applyBridge) now unconditionally clear skipped=false for MEAL_SLOTS. isGated evaluates edSlot.skipped || edSlot.late_arrival_placeholder — with skipped cleared, gated pre-arrival slots become droppable on next render.

dev.qa_notes: QA should verify via Playwright: (1) AC1 — drag Day 1 breakfast/lunch board card to sidebar; confirm data-droppable becomes 'true' on slot-drop div; (2) AC2 — drag a sidebar meal card onto the now-droppable slot; confirm drop succeeds and skipped stays false; (3) AC3 — confirm late_arrival_placeholder is not cleared (slot with late_arrival_placeholder: true still has data-droppable='false'); (4) AC4 — confirm dinner slot drag-and-drop is unaffected (no regression from task 20260526-201620 fixes).
